_comment: Every app-visible change serial 15 makes against serial 14 (scripts/validate.py --declared ci/serial15-declared.json --baseline ci/serial3-baseline.json --previous-ref <serial 14> --distros compat/distros.json). DRAFT 2026-11-16, unpublished: a sudoers that allows the package tool but not systemd-run (meshTerm 2.5 device check A155).

changes.reason: Changed (2026-11-16, meshTerm 2.5 A155): where systemd runs, the line first tries {{sudo}}systemd-run --wait --collect --quiet true (output hidden) and drops the systemd-run prefix when that fails. A sudoers that allows apt-get but not systemd-run refused the serial 13/14 line outright (sudo: not allowed to execute systemd-run), so Install Updates' restricted-sudo fallback, Copy Command and Open in Terminal upgraded nothing; it now runs the plain {{sudo}}apt-get install as 2.4 did. The probe runs after apt-get update, so a password sudo asks once. Same arguments and exit status where systemd-run is allowed.

Changed (2026-11-16): the same systemd-run probe as security-updates.apt, so a sudoers that allows dnf but not systemd-run runs the plain {{sudo}}dnf upgrade. Same arguments and exit status where systemd-run is allowed.
